blocks.explanation:
Chaar cosines ka jama hai aur dikhana hai ke total zero hai. Aise sawal mein asal kaam sahi jore (pairs) banana hai.
Ek kaam ki baat: jin do angles mein \(180^{\circ}\) ka farq ho, un ka aadha farq \(90^{\circ}\) banta hai aur \(\cos 90^{\circ} = 0\), is liye woh jora seedha zero ho jata hai.
Plan: \(15^{\circ}\) ko \(195^{\circ}\) ke saath aur \(105^{\circ}\) ko \(285^{\circ}\) ke saath jorein, aur \(\cos P + \cos Q\) lagayein.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: L.H.S. \(= \cos 15^{\circ} + \cos 105^{\circ} + \cos 195^{\circ} + \cos 285^{\circ}\).
Saabit karna hai: L.H.S. \(= 0\).
Tareeqa: Do pairs bana kar
\[\cos P + \cos Q\]
\[= 2\cos\dfrac{P + Q}{2}\cos\dfrac{P - Q}{2}\]
lagayenge.

Regroup karein
\[\text{L.H.S.} = (\cos 195^{\circ} + \cos 15^{\circ})\]
\[+ (\cos 285^{\circ} + \cos 105^{\circ})\]
Kyun: Jama kisi bhi order mein ho sakta hai. Har jore mein angles ka farq \(180^{\circ}\) hai: \(195 - 15 = 180\) aur \(285 - 105 = 180\).

Pehla jora (\(P = 195^{\circ}\), \(Q = 15^{\circ}\))
\[\cos 195^{\circ} + \cos 15^{\circ}\]
\[= 2\cos 105^{\circ}\cos 90^{\circ} = 0\]
Kyun: Aadha jama \(\frac{210^{\circ}}{2} = 105^{\circ}\), aadha farq \(\frac{180^{\circ}}{2} = 90^{\circ}\). \(\cos 90^{\circ} = 0\), aur zero se multiply karne par sab zero.

Doosra jora (\(P = 285^{\circ}\), \(Q = 105^{\circ}\))
\[\cos 285^{\circ} + \cos 105^{\circ}\]
\[= 2\cos 195^{\circ}\cos 90^{\circ} = 0\]
Kyun: \(\frac{390^{\circ}}{2} = 195^{\circ}\) aur \(\frac{180^{\circ}}{2} = 90^{\circ}\). Phir wohi \(\cos 90^{\circ} = 0\).

Dono jore jama karein
\[\text{L.H.S.} = 0 + 0 = 0 = \text{R.H.S.}\]
Kyun: Dono brackets zero hain.

Tasdeeq allied angles se
\[\cos 195^{\circ} = -\cos 15^{\circ}\]
\[\cos 285^{\circ} = \cos 75^{\circ} = \sin 15^{\circ}\]
\[\cos 105^{\circ} = -\sin 15^{\circ}\]
Kyun: Ab jama \(\cos 15^{\circ} - \sin 15^{\circ} - \cos 15^{\circ} + \sin 15^{\circ} = 0\) \(\checkmark\). Ek doosra tareeqa bhi hai: \(15^{\circ}\) ko \(105^{\circ}\) ke saath jorein; woh bhi chalta hai lekin us mein \(\cos 240^{\circ} = -\tfrac{1}{2}\) lagana parta hai. Jo jora jaldi zero de, wohi behtar hai.

blocks.explanation:
Upar chaar sines, neeche chaar cosines, angles wohi. Yeh Question 3(ii) ka bara bhai hai.
Saabit kya karna hai? Fraction \(= \tan 5\theta\).
Plan: bahar wale angles (\(8\theta, 2\theta\)) ka jora aur andar wale (\(6\theta, 4\theta\)) ka jora. Dono ka aadha jama \(5\theta\) hai, is liye \(\sin 5\theta\) aur \(\cos 5\theta\) common nikal aayenge.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: L.H.S. \(= \dfrac{\sin 2\theta + \sin 4\theta + \sin 6\theta + \sin 8\theta}{\cos 2\theta + \cos 4\theta + \cos 6\theta + \cos 8\theta}\).
Saabit karna hai: L.H.S. \(= \tan 5\theta\).
Tareeqa: \(\sin P + \sin Q\) aur \(\cos P + \cos Q\) aise joron par jin ka aadha jama barabar ho. Jore chunne ka asool: pehla aakhri ke saath, doosra teesre ke saath.

Numerator ke jore
\[\sin 8\theta + \sin 2\theta = 2\sin 5\theta\cos 3\theta\]
\[\sin 6\theta + \sin 4\theta = 2\sin 5\theta\cos\theta\]
Kyun: \(\frac{8\theta + 2\theta}{2} = 5\theta\) aur \(\frac{6\theta + 4\theta}{2} = 5\theta\), dono barabar. Aadhe farq \(3\theta\) aur \(\theta\) hain. Agar \(2\theta\) ko \(4\theta\) ke saath jorte to aadhe jame alag hote aur kuch common na nikalta.

Common factor bahar nikalein
\[\text{Num.} = 2\sin 5\theta(\cos 3\theta + \cos\theta)\]
Kyun: \(2\sin 5\theta\) dono terms mein hai.

Denominator ke wohi jore
\[\cos 8\theta + \cos 2\theta = 2\cos 5\theta\cos 3\theta\]
\[\cos 6\theta + \cos 4\theta = 2\cos 5\theta\cos\theta\]
\[\text{Den.} = 2\cos 5\theta(\cos 3\theta + \cos\theta)\]
Kyun: Wohi angles, ab \(\cos P + \cos Q\) formula ke saath. Dekhein, bracket \((\cos 3\theta + \cos\theta)\) bilkul numerator jaisa hai.

Divide kar ke cancel karein
\[\text{L.H.S.} = \dfrac{2\sin 5\theta(\cos 3\theta + \cos\theta)}{2\cos 5\theta(\cos 3\theta + \cos\theta)}\]
\[= \dfrac{\sin 5\theta}{\cos 5\theta}\]
\[= \tan 5\theta = \text{R.H.S.}\]
Kyun: \(2(\cos 3\theta + \cos\theta)\) upar neeche dono mein hai, cancel (yeh maan kar ke zero nahi). \(\frac{\sin}{\cos} = \tan\).

Tasdeeq: \(\theta = 10^{\circ}\)
\[\text{Num.} \approx 2.8356, \quad \text{Den.} \approx 2.3794\]
\[\dfrac{2.8356}{2.3794} \approx 1.1918\]
\[\tan 50^{\circ} \approx 1.1918 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Calculator se dono sides barabar aaye.

blocks.explanation:
Yahan do cosines ke squares ka farq hai. Squares dekh kar ghabrayein nahi: algebra ka purana formula \(a^2 - b^2 = (a - b)(a + b)\) kaam aayega.
Saabit kya karna hai? L.H.S. \(= \sin\alpha\).
Plan: factorise karein, har bracket ko sum-to-product se product banayein, phir \(2\sin u\cos u = \sin 2u\) lagayein.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: L.H.S. \(= \cos^{2}A - \cos^{2}B\), jahan \(A = \frac{\pi}{4} - \frac{\alpha}{2}\), \(B = \frac{\pi}{4} + \frac{\alpha}{2}\).
Saabit karna hai: L.H.S. \(= \sin\alpha\).
Tareeqa: \(\cos^{2}A - \cos^{2}B = (\cos A - \cos B)(\cos A + \cos B)\), phir sum-to-product. \(A\) aur \(B\) ke naam rakhne se likhna chhota aur saaf ho jata hai.

\(A\) aur \(B\) ka aadha jama aur aadha farq
\[\dfrac{A + B}{2} = \dfrac{\pi}{4}\]
\[\dfrac{A - B}{2} = -\dfrac{\alpha}{2}\]
Kyun: \(A + B = \frac{\pi}{2}\), kyunke \(-\frac{\alpha}{2}\) aur \(+\frac{\alpha}{2}\) cancel. \(A - B = -\alpha\), kyunke \(\frac{\pi}{4}\) cancel aur \(-\frac{\alpha}{2} - \frac{\alpha}{2} = -\alpha\).

Jama wala bracket
\[\cos A + \cos B\]
\[= 2\cos\dfrac{\pi}{4}\cos\left(-\dfrac{\alpha}{2}\right)\]
\[= 2\cos\dfrac{\pi}{4}\cos\dfrac{\alpha}{2}\]
Kyun: Cosine even function hai: \(\cos(-u) = \cos u\). Minus andar se gayab ho gaya.

Farq wala bracket
\[\cos A - \cos B\]
\[= -2\sin\dfrac{\pi}{4}\sin\left(-\dfrac{\alpha}{2}\right)\]
\[= 2\sin\dfrac{\pi}{4}\sin\dfrac{\alpha}{2}\]
Kyun: Sine odd function hai: \(\sin(-u) = -\sin u\). Formula ka minus aur yeh minus mil kar plus ban gaye.
Dhyan dein: Yahan minus sign sambhalna sab se zaroori hai; aksar students ka jawab \(-\sin\alpha\) aa jata hai.

Brackets multiply karein
\[\text{L.H.S.} = \left(2\sin\dfrac{\pi}{4}\cos\dfrac{\pi}{4}\right)\times\]
\[\left(2\sin\dfrac{\alpha}{2}\cos\dfrac{\alpha}{2}\right)\]
Kyun: Chaar factors aur \(2 \times 2\) ko aise do groups mein rakha ke har group "2 sin cos" ban jaye, ek hi angle ke saath.

Double-angle formula lagayein
\[= \sin\dfrac{\pi}{2}\cdot\sin\alpha\]
\[= 1\cdot\sin\alpha = \sin\alpha = \text{R.H.S.}\]
Kyun: \(2\sin u\cos u = \sin 2u\). Pehle group mein \(u = \frac{\pi}{4}\) se \(\sin\frac{\pi}{2} = 1\), doosre mein \(u = \frac{\alpha}{2}\) se \(\sin\alpha\).

Tasdeeq: \(\alpha = 60^{\circ}\)
\[\cos^{2}15^{\circ} - \cos^{2}75^{\circ} \approx 0.9330 - 0.0670\]
\[= 0.8660 = \sin 60^{\circ} \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: \(\frac{\pi}{4} = 45^{\circ}\) aur \(\frac{\alpha}{2} = 30^{\circ}\), is liye angles \(15^{\circ}\) aur \(75^{\circ}\) bane. Dono sides barabar.

blocks.explanation:
Do sines ka product hai jin ke angles \(\frac{\pi}{4} - \theta\) aur \(\frac{\pi}{4} + \theta\) hain. Product dekh kar foran product formula yaad aana chahiye.
Saabit kya karna hai? L.H.S. \(= \frac{1}{2}\cos 2\theta\).
Plan: 2 ka factor banayein, \(2\sin\alpha\sin\beta = \cos(\alpha - \beta) - \cos(\alpha + \beta)\) lagayein, phir \(\cos\frac{\pi}{2} = 0\).
steps:
Diya gaya hai: L.H.S. \(= \sin\left(\frac{\pi}{4} - \theta\right)\sin\left(\frac{\pi}{4} + \theta\right)\).
Saabit karna hai: L.H.S. \(= \frac{1}{2}\cos 2\theta\).
Tareeqa: Product formula
\[2\sin\alpha\sin\beta\]
\[= \cos(\alpha - \beta) - \cos(\alpha + \beta)\]
jahan \(\alpha = \frac{\pi}{4} + \theta\), \(\beta = \frac{\pi}{4} - \theta\).

2 ka factor banayein aur order badlein
\[\text{L.H.S.} = \dfrac{1}{2}\left[2\sin\left(\dfrac{\pi}{4} + \theta\right)\sin\left(\dfrac{\pi}{4} - \theta\right)\right]\]
Kyun: 2 aur \(\frac{1}{2}\) mil kar 1 hain, value nahi badli. Bara angle pehle rakhne se \(\alpha - \beta\) positive aata hai.

Naye angles nikalein
\[\alpha - \beta = 2\theta\]
\[\alpha + \beta = \dfrac{\pi}{2}\]
Kyun: Farq mein \(\frac{\pi}{4}\) cancel aur \(\theta - (-\theta) = 2\theta\). Jama mein \(\theta\) cancel aur \(\frac{\pi}{4} + \frac{\pi}{4} = \frac{\pi}{2}\).

Formula laga kar simplify karein
\[\text{L.H.S.} = \dfrac{1}{2}\left[\cos 2\theta - \cos\dfrac{\pi}{2}\right]\]
\[= \dfrac{1}{2}[\cos 2\theta - 0]\]
\[= \dfrac{1}{2}\cos 2\theta = \text{R.H.S.}\]
Kyun: \(\cos\frac{\pi}{2} = \cos 90^{\circ} = 0\), is liye doosra term khatam. Dhyan dein: \(\frac{\pi}{2}\) radian \(90^{\circ}\) hi hai.

Tasdeeq: \(\theta = 15^{\circ}\)
\[\sin 30^{\circ}\sin 60^{\circ} = \dfrac{\sqrt{3}}{4}\]
\[\dfrac{1}{2}\cos 30^{\circ} = \dfrac{\sqrt{3}}{4} \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: \(45^{\circ} - 15^{\circ} = 30^{\circ}\) aur \(45^{\circ} + 15^{\circ} = 60^{\circ}\); \(\frac{1}{2}\cdot\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2} = \frac{\sqrt{3}}{4}\) dono taraf.

blocks.explanation:
Bilkul part (ii) wala pattern hai, bas angles \(\theta\) ke odd multiples hain.
Saabit kya karna hai? Fraction \(= \tan 4\theta\).
Plan: \(7\theta\) ko \(\theta\) ke saath aur \(5\theta\) ko \(3\theta\) ke saath jorein; dono ka aadha jama \(4\theta\).
steps:
Diya gaya hai: L.H.S. \(= \dfrac{\sin\theta + \sin 3\theta + \sin 5\theta + \sin 7\theta}{\cos\theta + \cos 3\theta + \cos 5\theta + \cos 7\theta}\).
Saabit karna hai: L.H.S. \(= \tan 4\theta\).
Tareeqa: \(\sin P + \sin Q\) aur \(\cos P + \cos Q\), jore \((7\theta, \theta)\) aur \((5\theta, 3\theta)\). Wohi asool: pehla aakhri ke saath, doosra teesre ke saath.

Numerator ke jore
\[\sin 7\theta + \sin\theta = 2\sin 4\theta\cos 3\theta\]
\[\sin 5\theta + \sin 3\theta = 2\sin 4\theta\cos\theta\]
\[\text{Num.} = 2\sin 4\theta(\cos 3\theta + \cos\theta)\]
Kyun: \(\frac{7\theta + \theta}{2} = \frac{5\theta + 3\theta}{2} = 4\theta\); aadhe farq \(3\theta\) aur \(\theta\). \(2\sin 4\theta\) common nikal aaya.

Denominator ke wohi jore
\[\cos 7\theta + \cos\theta = 2\cos 4\theta\cos 3\theta\]
\[\cos 5\theta + \cos 3\theta = 2\cos 4\theta\cos\theta\]
\[\text{Den.} = 2\cos 4\theta(\cos 3\theta + \cos\theta)\]
Kyun: Wohi angles \(\cos P + \cos Q\) formula ke saath; bracket numerator jaisa.

Divide kar ke cancel karein
\[\text{L.H.S.} = \dfrac{2\sin 4\theta(\cos 3\theta + \cos\theta)}{2\cos 4\theta(\cos 3\theta + \cos\theta)}\]
\[= \tan 4\theta = \text{R.H.S.}\]
Kyun: Common factor cancel (zero nahi maan kar), aur \(\frac{\sin}{\cos} = \tan\).

Tasdeeq: \(\theta = 10^{\circ}\)
\[\text{Num.} \approx 2.3794, \quad \text{Den.} \approx 2.8356\]
\[\dfrac{2.3794}{2.8356} \approx 0.8391\]
\[\tan 40^{\circ} \approx 0.8391 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Dono sides barabar. Dilchasp baat: yeh numbers part (ii) ke numbers ulte hain, kyunke \(\sin 10^{\circ} = \cos 80^{\circ}\) waghera.
